description: Language-agnostic laws of the mesh.edit widgets on a unit cube, a two-quad strip and a 3 by 3 grid. Edge ids are half-edge handles in face-corner order. Expected measures follow from the geometry (a flat bevel of 0.1 removes a prism of volume 0.005 and adds one chamfer face).
